name: So Bad
source:
In "So Bad," you are a new student at Goldwood University dealing with some mysterious incidents from your family's past.
You have questions about that, begin your journey and get those answers one by one.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/so-bad-v0-1-1-theblueink.134464/]F95 Zone[/url]]
translation:
在《So Bad》中，你是戈德伍德大学的一名新生，正在处理家族过去的一些神秘事件。
你对此有疑问，开始你的旅程并一一获得答案。​

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/so-bad-v0-1-1-theblueink.134464/]F95区[/url]]
